segments.he: בְּיוֹם שְׁלִישִׁי עֶרֶב יוֹם כִּפּוּר בָּאנוּ לְקוּשְׁטַנְדִּינָא הַנִּקְרָא אֶצְלֵנוּ סְטַנְבּוּל:
segments.en: In Constantinople — we stood on the ship from Tuesday Erev Yom Kippur after midday until Monday — the first day of Sukkos after the morning meal. For at first we wished to hire the very ship we had come on to Constantinople. [Apparently here a little is also missing.]
